hero.eyebrow: Mark Duroy · Former European pro · Austin, TX
hero.headline: Train like the pros who taught me.
hero.text: I raced the Belgian and Dutch classics in the '90s. Now I coach riders of every level, from first centuries to Cat 1 crits, with the same patient, no-nonsense structure that got me there.
hero.image_alt: Two riders on an open road under a dramatic sunset sky

intro.heading: Coaching that fits a real life
intro.text: Most riders don't need more miles. They need the right miles, enough rest, and someone who can see the whole season. I build your plan around your schedule, adjust it when life gets busy, and explain the *why* behind every session so you become a smarter rider, not just a fitter one.

steps.title: Free intro call
steps.text: Twenty minutes to talk about your riding, your goals and your week. No pressure, no sales pitch.

steps.title: Baseline & plan
steps.text: We set your training zones and I build a periodized plan in TrainingPeaks around your target events.

steps.title: Ride, review, adjust
steps.text: You ride. I review the data, check in, and adjust the plan when work, family or fatigue get in the way.

cta.heading: Ready for your best season?
cta.text: Every plan starts with a free conversation about where you are and where you want to go.
